title: Duality and Policy Evaluation in Distributionally Robust Bayesian Diffusion Control
abstract: arXiv:2506.19294v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study diffusion control problems under parameter uncertainty. Controllers based on plug-in estimation can be brittle due to potential distribution shifts. Bayesian control with a prior on the parameters offers a formulation with beliefs about such shifts. However, as with any Bayesian model, the prior may be misspecified. To mitigate misspecification and reduce over-pessimism compared to classical robust control approaches (e.g. \citet{hansen2008robustness}), we propose a distributionally robust Bayesian control (DRBC) formulation in which an adversary perturbs the prior within a divergence neighborhood of a baseline prior. We develop a strong duality result that reduces the distributionally robust prior evaluation to a low-dimensional optimization and yields a practical simulation-based policy evaluation and learning procedure with structured policy parameterizations. translated_title: 分布鲁棒贝叶斯扩散控制中的对偶性与策略评估
translated_abstract: 我们研究参数不确定性下的扩散控制问题。基于插件估计的控制器可能因潜在的分布偏移而变得脆弱。带有参数先验的贝叶斯控制提供了一种关于此类偏移的信念表述。然而，与任何贝叶斯模型一样，先验可能被错误设定。为了缓解错误设定并减少与经典鲁棒控制方法（例如，\citet{hansen2008robustness}）相比的过度悲观，我们提出了一种分布鲁棒贝叶斯控制（DRBC）公式，其中对手在基线先验的散度邻域内扰动先验。我们发展了一个强对偶结果，将分布鲁棒先验评估简化为低维优化，并产生了一种实用的基于模拟的策略评估和学习程序，具有结构化的策略参数化。我们在一个合成数据集上验证了该算法的效率。
tldr: 本文提出了一种分布鲁棒贝叶斯控制方法，通过强对偶性将先验评估简化为低维优化，从而在参数不确定下实现更稳健且不过度悲观的策略评估与学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a distributionally robust Bayesian control method that leverages strong duality to reduce prior evaluation to low-dimensional optimization, enabling robust yet less pessimistic policy evaluation and learning under parameter uncertainty.
